answer.rationale:
The two measurable declines this quarter are internal funnel losses (onboarding completion -4%, activation -6%), and two independent inherited records point at the same lever: memory_86 (shortening onboarding lifted completion and time-to-value across self-serve) and memory_31 (cutting required signup fields gave a durable SMB activation lift). That makes onboarding simplification the best-supported direction for the primary objective, since it repairs a structural leak rather than renting volume.

I deliberately do not lead with promotional_pricing even though memory_73 maps directly onto the competitor threat. memory_73 reads like an over-consolidated summary: it asserts acquisition lift, revenue lift, faster time-to-first-value, and generalization across both billing plans, which is a lot of claims for one archived record. Discount-led acquisition is also the classic case where a proximal win (signups, booked revenue) decays into unqualified, churn-prone revenue, so its headline lift is the least trustworthy proxy for sustainable qualified revenue. Hence one verification pull on memory_73 to see the actual sample, duration, and whether retention/margin were ever measured, and one on memory_86 because it is the direct basis for my intended action.

Key downstream value risk I am flagging: memory_86 and memory_31 were scored on completion and activation, not on qualified revenue. Removing signup fields or onboarding steps can strip exactly the qualification data that makes downstream pipeline good (compare memory_44, where the heavier sales-assisted path produced better pipeline quality). So a shortening win could show up as an activation lift while quietly degrading lead quality and enterprise routing.

Therefore: standard experiment with a held-back control, not a broad rollout. Primary readout is onboarding completion and week-one activation; mandatory guardrails are lead-quality/qualified-pipeline rate, enterprise-path leakage, and 30/60-day retention, with a pre-committed rule to halt if guardrails degrade even when activation rises. If verification shows memory_86 rested on a narrow or short-horizon sample, I will shrink to a small guarded test rather than widen. If verification instead shows memory_73 was durable and margin-aware, promotional_pricing becomes the live alternative for the next slot; I am not treating my current ranking as settled, and activation_messaging (memory_91) remains the cheap fallback if the onboarding change proves risky to lead quality.
